generic_domain.justification: Software Engineering is a broader field that encompasses Empirical Software Engineering. While both deal with the systematic approach to developing and maintaining software, Software Engineering as a domain includes all aspects of software development, methodologies, tools, and practices. Empirical Software Engineering, on the other hand, specifically focuses on the empirical analysis of software systems and processes to improve understanding and decision-making. Therefore, it is more specific compared to Software Engineering, making Software Engineering the more generic Research Domain.
